metadata.description: Vendor-signed skill packs for IBM Bob. Install with `uvx bob-skills add <pack>`; other agents may read this manifest to discover packs.

plugins.name: bob-essentials
plugins.description: The marketplace inside Bob: find and install packs from chat, audit a skill before anyone trusts it, check the setup from hooks to MCP servers, and write new skills, modes, rules and commands. Ships /skills-add and a security rule that every task follows.

plugins.name: ibm-watsonx-data-integration
plugins.description: Build, run, diagnose and operate data flows in IBM watsonx.data integration (DataStage, pyflow) from natural language: flow lifecycle, DataStage and pyflow authoring, failed-run investigation, engine knowledge and bug reports. IBM's official skills, used with the Agentic Data Integration MCP server on IBM Cloud.

plugins.name: office-docs
plugins.description: Create, edit, fill and extract Word documents, PowerPoint decks and Excel workbooks from Bob with python-docx, python-pptx and openpyxl. Original IBM skills with tested helper scripts; nothing leaves the machine.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: From a topic or your own data to a deck and the talk around it: one headline per slide, a style picked from five, charts and pictures. The same storyboard builds an interactive HTML deck, a printable PDF and a 16:9 PowerPoint. Original IBM skills, offline.

plugins.name: wxo-adk
plugins.description: The six official watsonx Orchestrate ADK skills for the whole agent lifecycle (requirements, SOP, build, audit, telemetry, instruction quality) plus IBM's official wxo-agent-architect skill, the ADK and documentation MCP servers, an ADK rule, a /wxo-deploy command and a wxo-builder mode.

plugins.name: wxo-talk-with-your-data
plugins.description: Turn an Excel or CSV file into a text-to-SQL agent on watsonx Orchestrate and show it on a demo page with the embedded chat. SQLite bundled inside the Python tool, no external database for the prototype. Database sources and an Orchestrate refresh flow come in 1.2.

plugins.name: anthropic-dev-kit
plugins.description: Build MCP servers that expose your APIs to agents, test web applications with Playwright, and design frontends that do not look generated. The Apache-2.0 skills from Anthropic's public skills repository.

plugins.name: openai-dev-tools
plugins.description: Everyday developer skills from the Codex skills catalog: work in Jupyter notebooks, fix failing GitHub CI runs from the logs, and scaffold command-line tools. PDF work lives in the IBM office-docs pack.

plugins.name: openai-security
plugins.description: Security review skills from the Codex skills catalog: apply security best practices to a codebase, build a threat model, and map security ownership across a repository.

plugins.name: google-cloud-data
plugins.description: Work with BigQuery from an agent: basics, BigFrames data science, AI and ML in BigQuery, plus gcloud CLI guidance. Curated from Google's official agent skills.

plugins.name: hashicorp-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform the way HashiCorp writes it: style guide, tests, policy as code, module refactoring, and importing existing infrastructure with search. Curated from hashicorp/agent-skills.

plugins.name: microsoft-azure-ops
plugins.description: Day-to-day Azure work from an agent: look up resources, manage storage, analyse cost, check compliance and quotas, diagnose failing resources and run compute. Curated from Microsoft's official skills repository.

plugins.name: microsoft-foundry
plugins.description: Build and operate agents and models on Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry): projects, deployments, evaluation, tracing and the Foundry SDKs. Microsoft's most installed agent skill, curated from the official repository.

plugins.name: confluent-kafka
plugins.description: Build Kafka producers, consumers and Kafka Streams apps with Schema Registry, bring unmanaged schemas under Schema Registry with PII tags, write Flink SQL and Java UDFs, set up CDC pipelines into Iceberg or Delta tables with Tableflow, and plan a move from AWS MSK to Confluent Cloud. Confluent's official skills, curated from confluentinc/agent-skills with the evals Confluent scores them against.
